collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — LUCK, OMENS AND LAVASTONES (LO-01 to LO-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager's left ear has been ringing all morning, which means somebody is saying something nice.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject)'s left ear has been ringing all morning. In (subject.his/her) family, that means somebody is talking about (subject.him/her). Left ear, something nice. Right ear, something not so nice. (subject) has been walking round the village all morning, trying to work out who it is.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) asks everyone (subject.he/she) meets whether they've been talking about (subject.him/her). Most say no. Two say yes: one was telling a story about the time (subject) fell in the stream, and one was saying (subject) makes good bowls. "Left ear," says (subject), satisfied. "The bowls." (subject.He/She) ignores the stream story completely.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) gets on with (subject.his/her) day. By the afternoon, the ringing has stopped. At dinner, (friend) mentions in passing that the elders were all saying earlier how helpful (subject) has been lately. (subject) almost drops (subject.his/her) bowl. "Left ear," (subject.he/she) whispers. (friend) has no idea what (subject.he/she) is talking about.
